description: This file contains implementation of functions related to pattern matching and analysis of JIT nodes in the context of ONNX conversion, including source range comparison and traversal of slice and select nodes associated with index operations.

classes.name: IndexingPatternFinder
classes.description: A class providing methods to analyze indexing patterns within JIT nodes for ONNX pattern conversion, including source comparison and extraction of associated slice and select nodes.

methods.name: bool IsSameSource(const Node * n,const Node * m)
methods.description: Compares the source ranges of two nodes to determine if they originate from the same source location.

methods.name: std::vector<Node * > FetchSliceAndSelect(const Node * node)
methods.description: Traverses upstream nodes from a given node to collect all associated slice and select nodes that originate from the same source, aiding in constructing index tensors for pattern conversion.
